title: Active military personnel bring UAP videos to the congressman

tellings.quote: I get people from that are active military personnel that come to me as a member of Congress and and have videos that they they'll show me

plain: Since 2023, active-duty military personnel have come to Congressman Eric Burlison's office to show him videos of UAP, the government's term for UFOs. Burlison tells Michels this first-hand: "I get people... that are active military personnel that come to me as a member of Congress and have videos that they'll show me." If true, people in uniform are going around official channels to bring what they have recorded straight to lawmakers.
